sb.name: Animated Broom
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
sb.senses: blindsight 120 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 7

traits.name: False Object
traits.desc: If the broom is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the broom move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the broom is animate.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The broom doesn't provoke opportunity attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The broom makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Broomstick
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage.

sb.name: Animated Chained Library
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone
sb.senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 7

traits.name: False Object
traits.desc: If the library is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the library move or act, that creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to discern that the library is animate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The library makes two attacks.

actions.name: Chained Book
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and if the target is a creature, it is grappled (escape DC 12).

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Quill makes two attacks with his dagger and uses Supreme Mockery.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Quill's Fable (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: Quill utters a short fable while targeting up to five creatures within 30 feet of him that he can see. Each target that can hear Quill's magical fable must make a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw, taking 36 (8d8) psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Supreme Mockery
actions.desc: Quill hurls a string of insults laced with enchantments at a creature he can see within 60 feet of him. If the creature can hear Quill (though it need not understand him), it must succeed on a DC 17 Wisdom saving throw or take 66 (12d10) psychic damage and have disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Quill casts one of the following spells using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (save DC 17):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]]
- **3/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Hold Monster|hold monster]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Mind Blank|mind blank]], [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|teleport]]

sb.name: Bak Mei
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened, paralyzed

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (2/Day)
traits.desc: If Bak Mei fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Special Equipment
traits.desc: Bak Mei carries a staff of striking with 10 charges.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While Bak Mei is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, his AC includes his Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Bak Mei attacks three times: twice with Thunder Strike and once with his staff of striking.

actions.name: Thunder Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) thunder damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be deafened and stunned until the start of Bak Mei's next turn.

actions.name: Staff of Striking
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, or 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage when used with two hands, and Bak Mei can expend up to 3 of the staff's charges. For each expended charge, the target takes an extra 1d6 force damage.

actions.name: Heal Self (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.desc: Bak Mei regains 2d8 + 4 hit points, and all levels of exhaustion end on him.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: Bak Mei takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Bak Mei deflects the missile. The damage he takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 12. If the damage is reduced to 0, Bak Mei catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and Bak Mei has a hand free.

legendary_actions.name: Crane Dance
legendary_actions.desc: Bak Mei moves up to 20 feet. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Thunder Strike (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Bak Mei uses Thunder Strike.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Canopic Golem
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, charmed, deafened, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Limited Spell Immunity
traits.desc: The golem automatically succeeds on saving throws against spells of 7th level or lower, and the attack rolls of such spells always miss it.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The golem doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The golem makes two attacks.

actions.name: Slam
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 27 (4d10 + 5) force damage.

actions.name: Crystal Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) force damage.

reactions.name: Spell Deflection
reactions.desc: In response to a spell attack missing the golem, it causes that spell to hit another creature within 120 feet of it that it can see.

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The chwinga doesn't require air, food, or drink. When it dies, it turns into a handful of flower petals, a cloud of pollen, a stone statuette resembling its former self, a tiny sphere of smooth stone, or a puddle of fresh water (your choice).

traits.name: Evasion
traits.desc: When the chwinga is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The chwinga's innate spellcasting ability is Wisdom. It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material or verbal components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Guidance|guidance]], [[Tools/Spells/Pass Without Trace|pass without trace]], [[Tools/Spells/Resistance|resistance]]

actions.name: Magical Gift (1/Day)
actions.desc: The chwinga targets a humanoid it can see within 5 feet of it. The target gains a supernatural charm of the DM's choice. See chapter 7 of the Dungeon Masters Guide for more information on supernatural charms.

actions.name: Natural Shelter
actions.desc: The chwinga magically takes shelter inside a rock, a living plant, or a natural source of fresh water in its space. The chwinga can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect while inside this shelter, and the shelter doesn't impair the chwinga's blindsight. The chwinga can use its action to emerge from a shelter. If its shelter is destroyed, the chwinga is forced out and appears in the shelter's space, but is otherwise unharmed.

sb.name: Cloud Giant Ghost
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned, prone, restrained

traits.name: Ethereal Sight
traits.desc: The ghost can see 120 feet into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
traits.desc: The ghost can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.desc: The ghost regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn. If the ghost takes radiant damage or damage from a magic weapon, this trait doesn't function at the start of the ghost's next turn. The ghost dies only if it starts its turn with 0 hit points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The ghost makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Spectral Weapon
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) force damage.

actions.name: Etherealness
actions.desc: The ghost enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

actions.name: Wind Howl (Recharge 6)
actions.desc: The ghost emits a dreadful howl that summons a cold, biting wind. This wind engulfs up to three creatures of the ghost's choice that it can see within 60 feet of it. Each target is pulled up to 20 feet toward the ghost and must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw, taking 16 (3d10) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
The ghost casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability and requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Fog Cloud|fog cloud]]
- **3/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|telekinesis]]
- **1/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Control Weather|control weather]]

sb.name: Constructed Commoner
sb.condition_immunities: exhaustion, poisoned

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The commoner doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep, and it gains no benefit from finishing a short or long rest. When it drops to 0 hit points, it becomes a lifeless object.

actions.name: Club
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

sb.name: Corrupted Avatar of Lurue
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, paralyzed, poisoned

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The avatar makes two attacks: one with its hooves and one with its horn.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (8d6 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Horn
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 32 (8d6 + 4) necrotic damage. If the target is a humanoid, it must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or be transformed into a wolf under the avatar's control. This transformation lasts for 1 hour, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. The target's game statistics are replaced by the wolf's statistics, but it retains its hit points. The target is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its wolf form, and it can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech. The target's gear melds into the new form, and it can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The dragon tortoise makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws. It can make one tail attack in place of its two claw attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (3d12 + 7) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 20 Strength saving throw or be pushed up to 10 feet away from the dragon tortoise and knocked prone.

actions.name: Sand Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: The dragon tortoise exhales abrasive sand in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw, taking 52 (15d6) slashing damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Faerl has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put him to sleep.

actions.name: Rapier
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Faerl adds 2 to his AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, he must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

sb.name: Fungal Servant
sb.damage_immunities: necrotic, poison; bludgeoning, piercing, slashing from nonmagical attacks
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned
sb.languages: The languages it knew in life

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: The fungal servant has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: A destroyed fungal servant gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the fungal servant's heart.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The fungal servant is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). The fungal servant has the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Sacred Flame|sacred flame]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Guiding Bolt|guiding bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield Of Faith|shield of faith]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Silence|silence]], [[Tools/Spells/Spiritual Weapon|spiritual weapon]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Animate Dead|animate dead]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Divination|divination]], [[Tools/Spells/Guardian Of Faith|guardian of faith]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Contagion|contagion]], [[Tools/Spells/Insect Plague|insect plague]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Harm|harm]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The fungal servant can use its Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with its rotting fist.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to spores. The curse lasts until removed by the [[Tools/Spells/Remove Curse|remove curse]] spell or other magic.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.desc: The fungal servant targets one creature it can see within 60 feet of it. If the target can see the fungal servant, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of the fungal servant's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all fungal servants for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: The fungal servant makes one attack with its rotting fist or uses its Dreadful Glare.

legendary_actions.name: Blinding Spores
legendary_actions.desc: Blinding spores swirls magically around the fungal servant. Each creature within 5 feet of the fungal servant must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The fungal servant utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of the fungal servant that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of the fungal servant's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The fungal servant magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of the fungal servant, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of the fungal servant's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Whirlwind of Spores (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: The fungal servant magically transforms into a whirlwind of spores, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, the fungal servant is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by the fungal servant remain in its possession.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

sb.name: Gingwatzim
sb.speed: 30 ft., fly 30 ft. (hover) in its true form only
sb.condition_immunities: poisoned
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), passive Perception 10

traits.name: Alternate Forms
traits.desc: The gingwatzim has two alternate forms, both of which are chosen by its creator when the gingwatzim comes into being. One form is an exact duplicate of a Tiny nonmagical object (such as a book, dagger, or gemstone) that its creator is carrying or wearing when the gingwatzim is conjured. The other form can be any Tiny beast. Once these alternate forms are chosen, they can't be changed.

actions.name: Energy Drain (True Form Only)
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 16 (4d6 + 2) necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 12 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion. When the target finishes a short or long rest, the target loses every level of exhaustion gained from this attack.

actions.name: Change Shape
actions.desc: The gingwatzim changes from its true form—a 3-foot-diameter sphere of luminous ectoplasm—into one of its two alternate forms, or from one of those forms back into its true form. In object form, it can't move or make attacks but otherwise retains its statistics, and it is indistinguishable from the thing it is imitating. In beast form, it retains its hit points but otherwise uses the stat block of the beast it is imitating. When it dies, the gingwatzim reverts to its true form and then vanishes.

sb.name: Grippli Warrior
sb.languages: Grippli plus one other language (usually Common, Draconic, or Primordial)

traits.name: Hold Breath
traits.desc: The grippli can hold its breath for 20 minutes.

traits.name: Standing Leap
traits.desc: The grippli can leap 30 feet horizontally or 20 feet vertically from a standing position.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The grippli makes one attack with its tongue. If this attack hits, the grippli can make a melee attack using its trident against the same target.

actions.name: Tongue
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 12). Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the grippli can't grab another creature.

actions.name: Trident
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage if used with two hands to make a melee attack, plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the grippli had advantage on the attack roll.

actions.name: Shortbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) piercing damage if the grippli had advantage on the attack roll.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The hag can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.desc: The hag can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The hag's innate spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). She can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Vicious Mockery|vicious mockery]]

traits.name: Shared Spellcasting (Coven Only)
traits.desc:
While all three members of a hag coven are within 30 feet of one another, they can each cast the following spells from the wizard's spell list but must share the spell slots among themselves:

- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Charm Person|charm person]], [[Tools/Spells/Witch Bolt|witch bolt]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|alter self]], [[Tools/Spells/Suggestion|suggestion]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Glyph Of Warding|glyph of warding]], [[Tools/Spells/Slow|slow]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Blight|blight]], [[Tools/Spells/Polymorph|polymorph]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Dominate Person|dominate person]], [[Tools/Spells/Seeming|seeming]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Otto'S Irresistible Dance|Otto's irresistible dance]]

For casting these spells, each hag is a 12th-level spellcaster that uses Intelligence as her spellcasting ability. The spell save DC is 12 + the hag's Intelligence modifier, and the spell attack bonus is 4 + the hag's Intelligence modifier.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.desc: The hag covers herself and anything she is wearing or carrying with a magical illusion that makes her look like another creature of her general size and humanoid shape. The illusion ends if the hag takes a bonus action to end it or if she dies. The changes wrought by this effect fail to hold up to physical inspection. For example, the hag could appear to have smooth skin, but someone touching her would feel her rough flesh. Otherwise, a creature must take an action to visually inspect the illusion and succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern that the hag is disguised.

actions.name: Invisible Passage
actions.desc: The hag magically turns invisible until she attacks or casts a spell, or until her concentration ends (as if concentrating on a spell). While invisible, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, so she can be tracked only by magic. Any equipment she wears or carries is invisible with her.

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While the monk is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, its AC includes its Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The monk makes two attacks.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

sb.name: Jade Tigress
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, frightened

traits.name: Unarmored Defense
traits.desc: While Jade Tigress is wearing no armor and wielding no shield, her AC includes her Wisdom modifier.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Jade Tigress makes three attacks.

actions.name: Force Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) force damage, and if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of Jade Tigress's next turn.

actions.name: Poisoned Dart
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or gain 1 level of exhaustion.

actions.name: Heal Self (Recharges after a Long Rest)
actions.desc: Jade Tigress regains 2d8 + 2 hit points, and all levels of exhaustion end on her.

bonus_actions.name: Nimble Escape
bonus_actions.desc: Jade Tigress takes the Disengage or Hide action.

reactions.name: Deflect Missile
reactions.desc: In response to being hit by a ranged weapon attack, Jade Tigress deflects the missile. The damage she takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + 9. If the damage is reduced to 0, Jade Tigress catches the missile if it's small enough to hold in one hand and Jade Tigress has a hand free.

traits.name: Feline Agility
traits.desc: When K'Tulah moves on her turn in combat, she can double her speed until the end of the turn. Once she uses this ability, K'Tulah can't use it again until she moves 0 feet on one of her turns.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
K'Tulah is a 4th-level spellcaster. K'Tulah's spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks). K'Tulah has the following druid spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Produce Flame|produce flame]], [[Tools/Spells/Shillelagh|shillelagh]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Entangle|entangle]], [[Tools/Spells/Longstrider|longstrider]], [[Tools/Spells/Speak With Animals|speak with animals]], [[Tools/Spells/Thunderwave|thunderwave]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Animal Messenger|animal messenger]], [[Tools/Spells/Barkskin|barkskin]]

actions.name: Quarterstaff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit (+4 to hit with shillelagh), reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 3 (1d6) bludgeoning damage, 4 (1d8) bludgeoning damage if wielded with two hands, or 6 (1d8 + 2) bludgeoning damage with shillelagh.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) slashing damage.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Sight
traits.desc: Kharbek has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or sight.

traits.name: Exhaustion
traits.desc: Kharbek has 5 levels of exhaustion.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: Kharbek has advantage on saving throws against poison, and has resistance against poison damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Kharbek makes two melee attacks or two ranged attacks.

actions.name: Shortsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) piercing damage.

actions.name: Longbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, ranged 150/600 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Kiddywidget
sb.condition_immunities: blinded, deafened, exhaustion, paralyzed, petrified, poisoned

traits.name: Unusual Nature
traits.desc: The kiddywidget doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The kiddywidget makes two attacks: one with its bite and one with its tail.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is grappled by the kiddywidget (escape DC 8).

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) lightning damage.

sb.name: Lichen Lich
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned, stunned

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The lich makes four attacks.

actions.name: Poisonous Touch
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 17 (5d6) poison damage, and the target must succeed on a DC 19 Constitution saving throw or be poisoned for 1 minute. traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Valin has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.desc: While her heart remains in Alessia's body, Valin re-forms inside her sarcophagus, regaining all her hit points and becoming active again.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Valin Sarnaster is a 10th-level spellcaster. Her spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). Valin has the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Sacred Flame|sacred flame]], [[Tools/Spells/Thaumaturgy|thaumaturgy]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Command|command]], [[Tools/Spells/Guiding Bolt|guiding bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield Of Faith|shield of faith]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Hold Person|hold person]], [[Tools/Spells/Silence|silence]], [[Tools/Spells/Spiritual Weapon|spiritual weapon]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Clairvoyance|clairvoyance]], [[Tools/Spells/Dispel Magic|dispel magic]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Divination|divination]], [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|dimension door]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Contagion|contagion]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|scrying]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Harm|harm]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Valin can use her Dreadful Glare and makes one attack with her rotting fist.

actions.name: Rotting Fist
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain hit points, and its hit point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's hit point maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the [[Tools/Spells/Remove Curse|remove curse]] spell or other magic.

actions.name: Dreadful Glare
actions.desc: Valin targets one creature she can see within 60 feet of her. If the target can see Valin, it must succeed on a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw against this magic or become frightened until the end of Valin's next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies and mummy lords for the next 24 hours.

legendary_actions.name: Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Valin makes one attack with her rotting fist or uses her Dreadful Glare.

legendary_actions.name: Blinding Dust
legendary_actions.desc: Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around Valin. Each creature within 5 feet of Valin must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of her next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Blasphemous Word (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Valin utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within 10 feet of Valin that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a DC 16 Constitution saving throw or be stunned until the end of Valin's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Channel Negative Energy (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Valin magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within 60 feet of Valin, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain hit points until the end of Valin's next turn.

legendary_actions.name: Whirlwind of Sand (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Valin magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to 60 feet, and reverts to her normal form. While in whirlwind form, Valin is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone, restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by Valin remain in her possession.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Varnyr has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put Varnyr to sleep.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Varnyr makes two attacks.

actions.name: Cane
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: Varnyr adds 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit it. To do so, Varnyr must see the attacker and be wielding a melee weapon.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: The wood elf has advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and magic can't put the wood elf to sleep.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The wood elf's spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 12). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Dancing Lights|dancing lights]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Darkness|darkness]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|faerie fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|levitate]] (self only)

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
The wood elf is a 10th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The wood elf has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Poison Spray|poison spray]], [[Tools/Spells/Ray Of Frost|ray of frost]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Witch Bolt|witch bolt]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Alter Self|alter self]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]], [[Tools/Spells/Web|web]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Evard'S Black Tentacles|Evard's black tentacles]], [[Tools/Spells/Greater Invisibility|greater invisibility]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cloudkill|cloudkill]]

actions.name: Staff
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d6 - 1) bludgeoning damage, or 3 (1d8 - 1) bludgeoning damage if used with two hands, plus 3 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Summon Demon (1/Day)
actions.desc: The wood elf magically summons a quasit, or attempts to summon a shadow demon with a 50 percent chance of success. The summoned demon appears in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its summoner, acts as an ally of its summoner, and can't summon other demons. It remains for 10 minutes, until it or its summoner dies, or until its summoner dismisses it as an action.

sb.name: Zikran
sb.damage_resistances: damage from spells; nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing (from stoneskin); acid

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Zikran has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: Zikran can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Zikran is an 18th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). Zikran can cast [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|disguise self]] and [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]] at will and has the following wizard spells prepared:

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Bolt|fire bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Prestidigitation|prestidigitation]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Magic|detect magic]], [[Tools/Spells/Identify|identify]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Detect Thoughts|detect thoughts]], [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|mirror image]], [[Tools/Spells/Misty Step|misty step]]
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|counterspell]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]]
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Fire Shield|fire shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Stoneskin|stoneskin]]*
- **5th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Cone Of Cold|cone of cold]], [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Elemental|conjure elemental]], [[Tools/Spells/Scrying|scrying]], [[Tools/Spells/Wall Of Force|wall of force]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Globe Of Invulnerability|globe of invulnerability]]
- **7th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Teleport|teleport]]
- **8th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Mind Blank|mind blank]]*
- **9th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Time Stop|time stop]]

*Zikran casts these spells on itself before combat.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Zikzokrishka
sb.condition_immunities: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned
sb.senses: blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 24

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Zikzokrishka fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.desc: Zikzokrishka has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Zikzokrishka can use its Frightful Presence. It then makes three attacks: one with its bite and two with its claws.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 5 (1d10) lightning damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Tail
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +13 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 16 (2d8 + 7) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Frightful Presence
actions.desc: Each creature of Zikzokrishka's choice that is within 120 feet of the Zikzokrishka and aware of it must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's saving throw is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to the Zikzokrishka's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Lightning Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.desc: Zikzokrishka exhales lightning in a 90-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Each creature in that line must make a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw, taking 66 (12d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

legendary_actions.name: Detect
legendary_actions.desc: Zikzokrishka makes a Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Tail Attack
legendary_actions.desc: Zikzokrishka makes a tail attack.

legendary_actions.name: Wing Attack (Costs 2 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Zikzokrishka beats its tattered wings. Each creature within 10 feet of Zikzokrishka must succeed on a DC 21 Dexterity saving throw or take 14 (2d6 + 7) bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. After beating its wings this way, Zikzokrishka can fly up to half its flying speed.
